notes:
A CORRECTION, NOT A NEW ADJUDICATION. bmdb 1541 hostap TP back-pass, group 5 of 5 (src/l2_packet/l2_packet_pcap.c .. src/pasn/pasn_initiator.c). Same method as back-pass groups 1-4 (see correction-api00c-644-hostap-backpass-g1-task1541): each pointer-parameter TP row in batches 1-6 re-checked for an FP basis under ADR-0011 (aurora-lint bbf240e9, d9cb04d0).

RESULT: 128 TP rows re-checked. 46 are corrected TP -> FP here, and the rest stay TP; 2 of those that stay TP (src/pasn) had a proof found but are held pending the libpasn.so ruling. Two fresh-context refuters reviewed the 60 proposed flips (30 each) and upheld 46. They applied a strict field rule: a NULL test on a field (wpa_s->global->p2p, p2p->go_neg_peer) dominates a later call only if nothing in between can write that field, and any function-pointer callback or driver op run in between (cfg->stop_listen, find_stopped, group ie_update, wpa_drv_*) defeats it. The 14 rejected rows stay TP with rewritten reasons; they include the wifi_display.c p2p_set_wfd_* sites after p2p_set_wfd_ie_beacon and p2p_connect_send via p2p.c:2171. Upheld flips include p2p_ctrl_set's setters (test at ctrl_iface.c:7674, string parsing only in between), p2p_buf_add_channel_list (10 sites, each a wpabuf tested after alloc), p2p_peer_channels_check (7 sites, dev tested), and reply-buffer offsets bounded inside a tested reply (p2p_attr_text, ieee802_1x_kay_get_mib).

Mechanics follow bmdb 1490/1531 and the 1541 pilot: in-place edits keep each key; task-644-full-reaudit takes a row_count decrement and a superseded_rows record.

Counting basis: distinct (project, commit, file, line, rule) keys. No precision claim is made here.
